props.label: Created At
props.description: The date and time the record was created.

props.label: Updated At
props.description: The date and time the record was last updated.

props.label: End At
props.description: The actual date/time of when this Run ended (ie. production setup cleared)

props.label: Start At
props.description: The actual date/time of when this Run began (ie production setup added)

fields.label: Changeover Time
fields.description:
Changeover Time - is the actual time spent in changeover during this production run (seconds)

Aggregate Workcenter History Records falling between productionRun.startAt and productionRun.endAt where modeType.changeover = 1.

Note: multiple setups/changeovers that occur during a single production run will impact this number.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Duration (seconds) between the StartAt - EndAt for the entire Production Run

fields.label: Run Time
fields.description:
Run Time (seconds) Aggregation:

The aggregation looks at workcenterHistory records, that fall between the productionRun.startAt and productionRun.endAt to determine based on the Events (not Modes) whether the time was spend up, or down.

Planned Production Time = resource shift availability (total hours) between productionRun.startAt & productionRun.EndAt (do not excluded plannedDowntime, include all 'avialable' time); Planned Prod Time is always based on the calendar Available time for the workcenter. User must adjust the calendar - when appropriate to adjust the planned production time.

Run Time = Planned Production Time (Minus)-

workcenterHistory records where PlannedDowntime Or UnPlannedDowntime ==1

fields.label: Average Cycle Time
fields.description:
Average Cycle time (seconds)

((produced + scrap) / RunTime

fields.label: Earned Labor Hours
fields.description:
Earned Labor Hours:

(Produced (good only) / Standard Rate) * approvedWorkcenter.crewSize (for all outputs of the run)

fields.label: Earned Machine Hours
fields.description: (Produced (good only) / Standard Rate) - for all outputs of the run.

fields.label: Excluded Production
fields.description: Total Production where includeInProductionCounts = 0

fields.label: Excluded Scrap
fields.description: Total Scrap where includeInProductionCounts = 0

fields.label: Ideal Aggregate
fields.description: Sum of all Ideal rates for all production outputs - this defines the total expected throughput per hour for this Run.

fields.label: Performance
fields.description:
Performance = (idealRate * totalCount) / runTime

totalCount = produced+scrap

includeInProductionCounts = 1

fields.label: Planned Downtime
fields.description:
Sum of all 'unplanned downtime' during the productionRun - based on workcenter history where eventType.plannedDowntime=true

Duration in Seconds

fields.label: Produced
fields.description:
Total produced where includeInProductionCounts = 1

This  is the total throughput for the entire production run in good units made.

fields.label: Quality
fields.description:
scrap / totalProduction

totalProduction (produced + scrap), Where WorkcenterMode.includeInProductionCounts = 1

Pull from productionSetup.crewSize when Setup is Cleared.

Note: the crew size at the productionSetup may apply to multiple outputs.

fields.label: Scrap

fields.label: Total Production
fields.description: This is the total production for the run - including all included production + scrap entries.

fields.label: Unplanned Downtime
fields.description:
Sum of all 'unplanned downtime' during the productionRun - based on workcenter history where eventType.unplannedDowntime=true

Duration in Seconds

fields.label: Actual Labor Hours
fields.description:
Actual Labor Hours:

At ProductionRun StartAt - Create new WorkcenterHistory log entries for any open/existing labor clockins & update the historical records/close them out.

When a ProductionRun is ended, close all open labor entries, and open new ones for those that were not closed prior to the run ending.
